style: A steady court clerk addressing high school students: clear, respectful, measured, with quiet authority.
lines: Tap a case folder to open it. Then pick the charge and lock your standard of proof before you see any evidence.
Tap less than, greater than, or not equal to for the charge against the claim.
Tap a standard of proof. Then press Lock standard before opening the evidence.
Read each condition and its numbers. Tap Yes or No for each check.
The design and conditions have been reviewed. Press Admit evidence to open the evidence.
Compare the shaded tail with the locked standard. Press Make a verdict when you have weighed the evidence.
Tap Guilty or Not guilty. Then build the conclusion and press File sentence.
The standard was set before the evidence. Changing it now isn't fair to the defendant.
This court never finds a claim innocent. Not guilty means the evidence fell short. Tap Guilty or Not guilty.
Now the sentence: the interval of values the evidence supports. Compare it with the claim marker on the line.
Drag the claim slider along the line. Watch which claims this court would convict.
Pick a sample size and a true p, then press Hold 1,000 trials.
No random sample, no trial. Tap Case files, then open another folder.
Read the claim again. Tap the direction that matches what the case asks.
Charge entered. Press Set standard to continue.
That answer does not match this case. Read the question and numbers, then change Yes or No.
These are the same runners in both shoes. Use the twelve paired differences, not two independent samples.
That verdict does not follow the standard. Compare the p-value with alpha, then choose again.
Verdict entered. Choose the evidence conclusion and direction, then press File sentence.
Conclusion filed. Press View interval to hand down the confidence interval.
Conclusion filed with corrections noted. Press View interval to compare the claim and interval.
Check the evidence conclusion and direction against your verdict and charge. Then press File sentence.
The trials are filed. Compare simulated shares with the exact values, then change a control to test another court.
